mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity, which may alter mexiletine pharmacokinetics through reduced renal clearance and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; additionally, aminoglycosides can potentiate neuromuscular blockade affecting cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor renal function closely, measure drug levels of mexiletine if renal impairment develops, assess hearing function, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative antimicrobial agent if possible.
